message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"All evaluated points meet the 60 dB SQNR requirement, and the symmetric_preadd structure at coef_frac=15 already gives the smallest area (8520.246 um^2). Since precision can still be legally decreased (2 unvisited neighbors) while quality remains above threshold, lowering coefficient fractional precision is the most direct way to further reduce mapped area without risking numerical failure."}
